persona.label: Busy, wants a callback
persona.description: At work and won't do it by text. Wants a call tomorrow after 5pm. Agent should book a callback, not push.
persona.behavior: You are a nurse on shift and can't text right now. Your first reply is "at work, can't do this now." If offered options, ask for someone to call you tomorrow after 5pm. Don't answer qualification questions by text; if pressed, say "I'd rather just talk tomorrow." Once a callback is confirmed, say thanks and stop replying.

transcript.text: Hi Sam, this is Riley, an automated assistant with Harborline Home Loans, following up on the refinance inquiry you just submitted. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time.
at work, can't do this now.
Totally understand, Sam. I can ask 2-3 quick questions by text now, or book a call from a loan officer at a time that works for you. Which do you prefer?
can someone just call me tomorrow after 5pm?
Your call is booked. A licensed loan officer from Harborline will call you at this number tomorrow after 5pm to go over your refinance.

events.name: schedule_callback

input.notes: Sam Ortiz submitted a refinance inquiry on the website. They were at work and couldn't text, so none of their details have been collected yet (goal, home value, balance, rate, credit range, occupancy, timeline). Call at the number they texted from.

events.result: Callback booked. In one short message, confirm the time and say a licensed loan officer will call. Then close.

callback.notes: Sam Ortiz submitted a refinance inquiry on the website. They were at work and couldn't text, so none of their details have been collected yet (goal, home value, balance, rate, credit range, occupancy, timeline). Call at the number they texted from.

objections.rationale: Agent acknowledged ("Totally understand, Sam"), offered exactly the two playbook options ("2-3 quick questions by text now, or book a call"), then scheduled the callback when the borrower chose a time and closed politely.

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are short and warm and fit a borrower texting from work. The agent used the borrower's name, mirrored their timing ("tomorrow after 5pm") and asked nothing extra once they were busy.
judge.experience_rationale: The borrower's request was honored in one turn. Turn [4] states who will call ("A licensed loan officer from Harborline"), how ("at this number") and when ("tomorrow after 5pm").

annotations.note: Discloses AI identity up front ("an automated assistant"), names the inquiry source and gives the STOP opt-out.
Follows the busy playbook exactly, offering a quick-text option or a callback without pushing.
Confirms the callback with a clear who, how and when, and ends without adding any more asks to a busy borrower.
The confirmation could have added a polite sign-off (e.g., "Thanks, Sam"), but the close is otherwise clean.

judge.overall_notes: This is a clean, compliant handling of a busy borrower that follows the playbook and sets a clear callback. No rates, approvals or pressure appeared.
